description: Build a saved report again from the test results as they are now, as the report page's Update does: the same period, runs and options as when it was made, so problems dismissed, deleted or re-sorted since then are reflected. The report keeps its id, title and share link; its earlier content is replaced. Use it when a report failed, or to bring one up to date instead of making a new one. It builds in the background in about a minute and uses a language model: read it with get_report until its status is ready. Counts toward the daily limit on reports.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

report.description: The report's id, as list_reports shows it.
report.title: Report

name: rebuild_report
